## Location note There is **no `prototype/` folder** in this repo. The runnable prototype is **`frontend-demo/`** (Vue 3 + TypeScript + Ant Design Vue). Docs and `project-memory.md` treat it as the demo/prototype. --- ## 1. How the AI drawer/sidebar is implemented | Layer | File | Role | |-------|------|------| | **Drawer UI** | `c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\components\SmartAssistantDrawer.vue` | Right `a-drawer` (440px), title “敖钦辅助” | | **Global mount** | `c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\components\Layout\WorkbenchLayout.vue` | Single `` on every authenticated page | | **State / logic** | `c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\stores\workbench.ts` | Pinia store: open/close, context, messages, tasks, references, quick actions | | **Full-page workspace** | `c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\pages\Assistant\AssistantPage.vue` | Route `/assistant` — same store, richer task/reference/settings UI | | **Styles** | `c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\styles\global.css` | `.assistant-drawer*`, `.agent-*` (lines ~2720–3140, ~3018–3107) | | **Routing** | `c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\router\index.ts` | `/assistant` meta `title: '智能辅助中心'` | **Key functions (all in `workbench.ts`):** - `openAssistant(context, mode)` — sets context string + mode, opens drawer - `closeAssistant()` - `submitAssistant(question, mode)` — appends mock messages/tasks - `quickActions` (computed) — derives button labels from `assistantContext` substring rules - `activeTask` (computed) — current task from `activeTaskId` **Drawer structure** (`SmartAssistantDrawer.vue`): ```15:72:c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\components\SmartAssistantDrawer.vue ``` **Global trigger** (header on every layout page): ```119:123:c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\components\Layout\WorkbenchLayout.vue 打开智能辅助 ``` --- ## 2. Is it page-aware? (context, quick actions, buttons) **Partially — only at open time, via a free-text context string.** | What changes per page | How | |----------------------|-----| | **Context label** | `assistantContext` set when `openAssistant()` is called | | **Quick action labels** | `quickActions` computed from substring match on `assistantContext` | | **Assistant mode** | `knowledge` / `data` / `tool` / `insight` — affects mock reply title only | | **Drawer markup** | **Identical** on all pages — one shared component | **What does NOT change per page:** - Message thread (shared; starts with one fixed agent greeting) - Tasks list (seeded with one hardcoded “规划 V2 / V3 差异分析” task) - References (three static planning-focused snapshots) - Drawer layout, collapse panels, composer - No route watcher — navigating pages does **not** update context until user clicks open again **Quick-action rules** (`workbench.ts`): ```93:111:c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\stores\workbench.ts const quickActions = computed(() => { if ( assistantContext.value.includes('工作簿') || assistantContext.value.includes('编制') || assistantContext.value.includes('采集') ) { return ['解释当前填写规则', '定位这个异常怎么处理', '生成当前校验摘要'] } if (assistantContext.value.includes('版本')) { return ['解释当前版本差异', '生成复核摘要草稿', '列出需要确认的变化项'] } if (assistantContext.value.includes('调整')) { return ['解释约束冲突', '整理可调整参数', '生成调整任务草稿'] } if (assistantContext.value.includes('成果')) { return ['核对成果引用版本', '生成成果摘要草稿', '列出导出前检查项'] } return ['解释当前待办', '汇总阻断异常', '生成下一步处理建议'] }) ``` **Modes** (used in replies, not shown in drawer UI): ```32:37:c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\stores\workbench.ts const modeTitles: Record = { knowledge: '知识与口径查询', data: '结构化数据查询', tool: '规划工具任务', insight: '规律与版本解读', } ``` --- ## 3. Pages: shared drawer vs different “智能辅助” content ### Shared drawer (all authenticated routes) Every page under `WorkbenchLayout` gets the same `SmartAssistantDrawer`. Only the **context string** and **quick-action set** can differ. ### Full-page “智能辅助中心” (different UI, same session) `/assistant` → `AssistantPage.vue` — not a second drawer; it’s the expanded workspace (tasks / references / settings tabs) using the **same** `workbench` store. Drawer and full page share `messages`, `quickActions`, `tasks`, `references`. ### Page-specific entry points (custom context + mode + CTA label) These pages add their own header buttons; they still open the **same** drawer: | Page | File | Button label | `openAssistant(...)` call | |------|------|--------------|---------------------------| | 首页总览 | `DashboardPage.vue` | 询问当前工作 | `` `首页总览 / ${version}` ``, `'data'` | | 储量工作簿 | `ReserveCollectionPage.vue` | 解释规则 | `pageTitle` (`储量工作簿`), `'knowledge'` | | 方案编制 | `PlanningSchemePage.vue` | 表格助手 | `'规划工作流编制'`, `'tool'` | | 调整与排期 | `PlanningProfilePage.vue` | 解释无解原因 | `'产量剖面智能调整'`, `'tool'` | | 成果中心 | `PlanningOutputPage.vue` | 生成摘要草稿 | `'规划成果中心'`, `'knowledge'` | ### Pages with **only** global header “打开智能辅助” No page-local AI button; context = `route.meta.title`: | Route | `meta.title` | Quick-action bucket (header open) | |-------|--------------|-----------------------------------| | `/dashboard` | 首页总览 | Default | | `/reserve/history-cleaning` | 数据接入 | Default (no keyword match) | | `/reserve/analysis` | 储量洞察 | Default | | `/reserve/version` | 储量版本对比 | **版本** | | `/planning/collection` | 基础数据 | Default (`基础数据` ≠ `采集`) | | `/planning/workflow` | 方案编制 | **编制** → workbook set | | `/planning/profile` | 调整与排期 | **调整** | | `/planning/version` | 版本对比 | **版本** | | `/planning/output` | 成果中心 | **成果** | | `/assistant` | 智能辅助中心 | Default | | `/admin` | 系统管理 | Default | --- ## 4. Quick-action button labels (complete config) | Bucket | Trigger (context contains) | Labels | |--------|---------------------------|--------| | **Workbook / compile** | `工作簿`, `编制`, `采集` | 解释当前填写规则 · 定位这个异常怎么处理 · 生成当前校验摘要 | | **Version** | `版本` | 解释当前版本差异 · 生成复核摘要草稿 · 列出需要确认的变化项 | | **Adjustment** | `调整` | 解释约束冲突 · 整理可调整参数 · 生成调整任务草稿 | | **Output** | `成果` | 核对成果引用版本 · 生成成果摘要草稿 · 列出导出前检查项 | | **Default** | everything else | 解释当前待办 · 汇总阻断异常 · 生成下一步处理建议 | There is **no per-route config object** — only this string-matching computed property. --- ## 5. “Same sidebar everywhere” — evidence ### A. One component, one mount point ```143:144:c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\components\Layout\WorkbenchLayout.vue ``` ### B. Shared static session data (not page-derived) ```71:90:c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\stores\workbench.ts const messages = ref([ { id: 1, role: 'agent', text: '我会结合当前页面、版本和选中对象整理可复核的建议。', time: '刚刚' }, ]) const references = ref(defaultReferences) const tasks = ref([ { id: 'task-version', title: '规划 V2 / V3 差异分析', mode: 'insight', // ... }, ]) const activeTaskId = ref('task-version') ``` On a reserve or admin page, the drawer still shows planning V2/V3 task and planning references. ### C. Drawer and full workspace bind to the same store ```38:42:c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\components\SmartAssistantDrawer.vue
当前页面可协助 ``` ```30:33:c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\pages\Assistant\AssistantPage.vue
``` Same `quickActions`, same `messages` — only layout differs. ### D. Context/mode gaps - Header uses `route.meta.title`; page buttons use **different** strings → inconsistent quick-action buckets (e.g. dashboard page button `首页总览 / V3` stays in **default** bucket; header `首页总览` also default). - `assistantMode` is never rendered in the drawer (no mode chips/tabs). - `submitAssistant` always returns the same template reply; no page-specific logic: ```123:134:c:\Users\win\Desktop\敖钦储能项目\frontend-demo\src\stores\workbench.ts function submitAssistant(question = assistantPrompt.value, mode = assistantMode.value) { const text = question.trim() if (!text) return // ... messages.value.push({ id: id + 1, role: 'agent', text: `已创建“${title}”草稿，已关联${assistantContext.value}的页面上下文与版本快照，需人工复核后使用。`, time: '刚刚', }) ``` ### E. PRD intent vs current implementation PRD expects sidebar to explain **current charts/tables/version diffs** per page and one session across sidebar + workspace (`07-产品需求文档_PRD_V0.2.md` §4.4). Current code only swaps a context **label** and three quick-action strings; tasks/references/messages stay global mock data. --- ## Summary | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | **Where is the prototype?** | `frontend-demo/` (Vue SPA), not `prototype/` | | **Drawer implementation** | `SmartAssistantDrawer.vue` + `workbench.ts` + `global.css` | | **Page-aware?** | **Label + quick actions only** (substring on context); structure and session data are shared | | **Different full-page AI** | Only `/assistant` (`AssistantPage.vue`) — same store, richer inspector | | **Page-specific configs** | 5 pages with custom `openAssistant` CTAs; no centralized route→config map | | **Main gap** | One drawer, one global mock session; “当前页面可协助” is mostly cosmetic | **Completed:** Mapped AI assistant architecture across `frontend-demo`. **Verified:** Read-only file/grep analysis (no runtime). **Remaining risks:** Context string matching is brittle; static tasks/references undermine per-page assistant story; no auto-sync on route change.
